data.title: Ethereum staking shows bullish signs as entry q... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's staking data reveals a strong bullish sentiment with about 1.23 million ETH waiting to be staked, while only 1,682 ETH are queued for withdrawal. The total staked ETH increased from 41.5 million to 44.2 million between August and October, raising the staked share of circulating supply from 34% to 36.19%. However, ETH's price dropped 5.2% in the past week to $2,244.74, with bearish market indicators and external uncertainties like the Federal Reserve meeting and U.S. midterm elections casting doubt on the positive staking trend's impact on price.
data.author: AMBCrypto
